text: Traveling to a new country is an exciting experience. Before the trip, planning is important. You need to book tickets, find a hotel, and decide what to see. When you arrive, everything feels different. You meet new cultures, try delicious food, and learn about daily life in another place. Sometimes there are language barriers, and you cannot understand people. But you can use gestures or a translation app to communicate. These small problems often become funny stories later. After the trip, you return home with wonderful memories that stay with you forever.
